status: 2D city/route proposal only; not playable and no 3D changes
coordinate_system: local planning metres, north up; not a terrain-aligned runtime bake
design_focus: compact city with a civic center, connected neighborhoods and two racing choices

route_contract.branch_gates: Require an ordered midpoint gate on the selected branch; no straight-through shortcut credit.
route_contract.progress: Project arc length onto the active edge, then map it into a shared split-to-merge progress interval.
route_contract.merges: Reserve the merge corner and keep both approaches free of plots; lane smoothing, visibility and traffic priority remain implementation work.
route_contract.nonrace_streets: Connected city/traffic network, not additional race shortcuts. Closure/signage design and branch validation are future runtime work.

limits: Race integration, corner radii and merge traffic are not implemented.
City massing is a plan; proposed plots do not replace the canonical lot IDs/quotas.
Current models, heights, textures, physics and playable race remain unchanged.
Diagonal-cut blocks need dedicated corner frontage design before construction.
